Message.Name: Order Book Retransmission Delimiter Message
Message.Description: The Orderbook retransmission delimiter message is set to clean then update the market sheet with the orders from previous days still remaining in the order book

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the time when the message is generated

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: ApplicationID
Field.Description: Code identifying the application where the orderbooks are retransmitted

Field.Name: InstanceNum
Field.Description: Indicates the number of trading units for which the orderbooks are rebroadcast

Field.Name: RetransmissionIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates the status of the retransmission for the instance of the trading engine
